name: mountain-scout
prompt: 用更新后的工作流生成一个新角色测试。测试角色：半侧身朝右的成年男性山地斥候，黑色短发和短胡须，铁锈橙短外套、灰色长裤、棕色短靴与无指手套。制作待机、原地行走、原地跑步及徒手攻击。

character.description: Adult male mountain scout, short black hair, neat dark beard, rust-orange short jacket with raised collar and dark belt, slate-grey flexible trousers, brown ankle boots and dark fingerless gloves. Compact athletic proportions. Crisp hand-painted 2D game art with simple consistent shading.

actions.name: walk
actions.description: 朝右原地行走，交替支撑，脚掌接地

actions.name: run
actions.description: 朝右原地跑步，抬腿、屈肘摆臂

actions.name: attack
actions.description: 蓄势、向右出拳、跟随、收拳恢复
